x1c.centering_ranking_invariant_note: centering=c_i-mean_j(c_j) with a plain linear dot-product score shifts every eligible segment's score in a sample by the SAME additive constant (<query,mean> is i-independent), so top-2/hit@2 CANNOT differ from the uncentered condition -- this is an algebraic identity, not an empirical result. stock_centered/u_eq_q_centered hit2 values below are expected to equal stock/u_eq_q exactly (mod float noise) for this reason. A renormalize-after-centering or top-1-PC-removal variant (rev1 spec's original phrasing) would NOT have this invariance, but was not what this task's brief specified; flagged for coordinator follow-up rather than substituted unilaterally.
